topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: Well, there's sun in the skies and a brisk wind from the east today, and it seems our good friend Peter's been given a new plot to tend to, right in the heart of the village. They say it's fertile, ripe with promise, just like when the colts learn to run. Peter's always been good with his hands, and now he's got a chance to show what he can do with herbs and spices. I reckon he'll bring us more than just turnips this time. It's a grand change, and I think the saints are smiling on us, sending Peter just where he needs to be. I'll be sure to stop by and see how he's doing, maybe share a few seeds from my own patch.
